frontmatter.name: auth-rbac
frontmatter.description: Authentication and role-based access control for AppealAI. Use when adding or changing login, registration, logout, token refresh, password reset, invites, session cookies, CSRF, roles (admin, reviewer, biller), requireAuth/requireRole middleware, or rate limiting on auth routes.

frontmatter.name: agent-pipeline
frontmatter.description: Background AI jobs in AppealAI — BullMQ queue/worker pattern, retries, idempotency, Claude API calls with Zod-validated structured output, storing prompt version and token usage, and keeping secrets/PHI out of logs. Use for extraction, classification, evidence, drafting or any LLM or long-running job.

frontmatter.name: multi-tenancy
frontmatter.description: Organization (tenant) isolation for AppealAI. Use whenever creating a table, writing a query or repository, adding an endpoint that reads or writes org data, or writing tests — every table has org_id and every query is scoped by it.

frontmatter.name: api-endpoint
frontmatter.description: How to add or change an Express API endpoint in apps/api — route → controller → service → repository layering, Zod validation, the shared error format, pagination and OpenAPI comments. Use for any new or modified HTTP route.

frontmatter.name: reviewer
frontmatter.description: Security and code reviewer for AppealAI. Use after finishing each phase, or before a merge, to review the changes against the project rules and skills. Read-only; reports findings, changes nothing.

frontmatter.name: rag-retrieval
frontmatter.description: Payer-policy RAG for AppealAI — chunking policy documents, embeddings in pgvector (policy_docs/policy_chunks), similarity queries scoped by org, the citation format (doc, section, page), and the "no source, no claim" rule for appeal drafting. Use for ingestion, retrieval, evidence or any cited AI output.

frontmatter.name: phi-security
frontmatter.description: Protecting PHI and sensitive data in AppealAI — log redaction, encryption at rest for uploaded files, short-lived signed URLs, and audit logging of every read/write of claim data. Use when touching logging, file upload/download, storage, claim/denial/document/appeal data access, or error reporting.

frontmatter.name: db-migrations
frontmatter.description: Database schema changes with Drizzle in apps/api — editing src/db/schema, generating migrations, custom SQL migrations, and seed scripts with synthetic data. Use for any table, column, index, enum or seed change.

frontmatter.name: k8s-deploy
frontmatter.description: Containerisation and Kubernetes deployment for AppealAI (k3s on a VPS) — Dockerfile standards, health/readiness probes, resource requests/limits, HPA, secrets handling, and the rollout checklist. Use when editing Dockerfiles, docker-compose, infra/k8s manifests or the deploy workflow.

frontmatter.name: testing
frontmatter.description: Testing conventions for AppealAI — Vitest unit tests, Supertest API tests, Playwright e2e, synthetic fixtures, and what must be tested for every feature (auth, tenancy, validation, AI output). Use when writing or reviewing any feature or test.
